sentences.text: Mr. Ashok Kumar Sehrawat, Dag, Haryana.

1 This second petition has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
for grant of regular bail in case F.I.R. No.112 dated 08.04.2023 registered under Sections 379/420
Ipc & Sections 201/120-B/149 Ipc (added later on ) at Police Station Butana, Karnal.
The same is taken on 3 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was neither named in the FIR nor in the supplementary statement.
It is being claimed that the petitioner has been identified in CCTV footage.
He further relies upon order passed by this Court in CRM-M-48805- 2023 dated 03.10.2023 whereby co-accused namely Shyam Sunder @ Shyam stands admitted to bail.
He submits that the case of the petitioner is on better footing, as Shyam Sunder was named in the supplementary statement whereas the petitioner was not.

Manjeet vs State Of Haryana on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65242729/
1 POOJA SHARMA 2023.10.19 17:46 CRM-M-52267 of 2023 (O&M) 2 2023: PHHC:136578 4
Challan stands presented and thus there can not be any apprehension that the petitioner shall tamper with the evidence.
5 Learned State counsel on the other hand opposes the bail plea and submits that the petitioner has been identified in the CCTV footage and there is another FIR pending against him.

However, it is not disputed by him that co-accused Shyam Sunder @ Shyam already stands admitted to bail and in the other case F.I.R. No.479 dated 21.07.2009 registered for offences punishable under Sections 148/149/323/324/506 IPC at Police Station City Karnal, the petitioner has earned bail.

6 Having heard rival contention and after going through records of the case and considering the fact that the co-accused-Shyam Sunder @ Shyam already stands admitted to bail vide order dated 03.10.2023 passed in CRM-M-48805-2023 and the incarceration suffered by the petitioner, the present petition is allowed.
The petitioner is ordered to be released on bail on his furnishing bail/surety bonds to the satisfaction of the Ld. Trial Court/Duty Magistrate, concerned.
7 Needless to say that anything observed herein shall not be construed to be an opinion on the merits of the case.

(PANKAJ JAIN ) JUDGE 19.10.2023 Pooja sharma-I Manjeet vs State Of Haryana on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65242729/
